name: Record of Asturion War Redux
source:
Asturion, home to humans, elves, halflings and more, is a continent in spring. Having recently emerged from a series of endless battles, a tentative calm has overtaken the nations. People were hopeful that, perhaps, these halcyon days could continue.

However, this was not to be the case. The war machine of the Rascian Empire launched coordinated attacks on its neighbours. The strikes were brutal, unrelenting and overwhelming to the point that nation after nation crumbled under the march. But one man seeks to turn the tides of war, the much-loved, oft-praised Prince of Mercia, Marek. Can he stand against the Imperial war machine? 

[From [url=https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/110358993]Pixiv[/url]]
